## Review
- Correct: The requested Phase 2A fixes are present: attention row keys include state/detail and all other captured display fields (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:236-255,887-904`); composer slash-menu handling returns before processing any composing key (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/app.rs:1461-1471`); polling-driven removal/replacement restores focus to the search input when focus leaves the open popover (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:588-615`); compact counts include only `NeedsHuman` and `Running` (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:258-267,752-763`); the count is non-shrinking and no narrow-width rule hides it (`styles/island.css:104-125,495-554`); the live region uses the same `chip_status` formatter (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:752-765,834-838`); the idle dot is neutral while only running uses accent (`styles/island.css:65-90`); and disclosure detail has no inner height/overflow scroller (`styles/island.css:320-330`). Polling also prevents overlapping fetches and independently preserves each last-good snapshot on failure (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:2602-2648`).
- Blocker: A stale agent reconnect can still replace and close the current session's new EventSource. The generation is checked before `rehydrate_transcript(...).await` (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1814-1849`) but not again before creating and installing the source (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1851-1870`). If a session switch occurs during that await, `connect()` advances the generation and installs the new session stream, then the resumed stale task calls `replace_event_source`, closes that new stream, and stores its old-session stream. This is not self-healing: the current loop ignores the close-generated subscription errors (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1904-1912`) and can remain waiting on the explicitly closed source, while the stale stream is idle and generation-gated. Re-check `sse_generation == generation` immediately after rehydration/before `EventSource::new` (or make installation generation-conditional) so a stale task cannot take ownership of the slot.
